Name: Personal FarmType
Author: Kanjinuma
Description:
[center]"This was very difficult for me to learn, but I hope you enjoy." 

[i][b]-----/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/-----[/b][/i][/center][center][u][b][size=3][u][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#93c47d][size=3][b]Features:[/b][/size][/color][/font][/u][/size]﻿
[/b][/u][b][/b][b]. [/b]A larger map layout.
[b].[/b] Multiple Large crop fields.
[b]. [/b]A "Grass Only" variant for new saves.
[b].[/b] Designated Animal, Fruit Tree , & Slime Hutch Areas.
[b].[/b] Customizable Starting Furniture, Wallpapers, Flooring, & TV.
[b].[/b] An Optional Cave for toggling monsters.
[b]. [/b]An Optional Quarry area. [color=#f4cccc][size=1]( SDV 1.6 Feature)
[/size][/color][b]. [/b]Optional Fast travel Minecarts around the farm. ([size=1]Top to bottom) [color=#f4cccc]( SDV 1.6 Feature)[/color][/size]
[b].[/b] A Custom Farm Image on your Map.
[size=1](And plenty of other configs for your optional pleasure lol.)[/size][/center][center][u][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][b]
[color=#a4c2f4]Compatibility﻿:[/color]
[/b][/size][/font][/u][b].[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=description]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿﻿ [size=1](Custom Map & Grove event.)
[/size][b].[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14411?tab=description&BH=1]Aimon's Fancy Farmhouse[/url] [size=1](Formerly: "Redesigned Farmhouse Alternative".)[/size]﻿﻿
[b].[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/39003995?tab=user+files]Elle's[/url] Seasonal Buildings, Animals, Horses [size=1](etc.)[/size]
[b]. [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley Unofficial 1.6[/url]﻿﻿[size=2] [/size][size=1](Custom Map & Icon.) [color=#f4cccc](SDV 1.6 Feature)[/color]
[/size][b]. [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255/]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor﻿[/url] [size=1](Custom Map & Icon.) [/size][color=#f4cccc](SDV 1.6 Feature)[/color]
[b].[/b][size=2] [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url][size=2] [/size][size=1](Custom Map & Icon.) [color=#f4cccc](SDV 1.6 Feature)[/color][/size]﻿
[b]. [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11881]Integrated Minecarts[/url] [size=1](For quick travel around the valley. :D) [color=#f4cccc](SDV 1.6 Feature[/color][color=#b6b6b6]?[/color][color=#f4cccc])[/color][/size]﻿﻿
[size=1]*(And any other mod that doesn't directly effect the farm.)*[/size]﻿

[u][b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][u][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#8e7cc3][size=3][b]Optional Mods﻿:[/b][/size][/color][/font][/u][color=#b4a7d6]﻿[/color]
[/size][/font][/b][/u][spoiler][b]. [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13804]CustomFarmLoader (CFL)[/url] [size=1](Gives Players a gamepad friendly Farm Selection UI.)
[/size][color=#ead1dc][size=1][ ****REQUIRED FOR ANDROID SUPPORT.**** ][/size][/color][size=1][color=#ea9999]
[/color][color=#b6b6b6]([u]Make sure ContentPatcher is also present when in use.[/u])[/color][/size]﻿
[b]. [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes[/url]﻿ [size=1](Config can enable axe breaking bushes.)[/size]
[size=1][Bushes cannot be removed once spawned, without this mod.[/size][size=1]][/size][size=2][/spoiler][/size]
[u][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ffe599][size=3][b](Planned) Features﻿:[/b][/size][/color][/font][/u]﻿
[spoiler][b]. [/b]Custom seasonal events. [size=1](One opens every season when [color=#d9ead3]requirements [/color]are met.)[/size][size=1]
[/size][b]. [/b]Compatibility with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18387]Map Editor Extended[/url] mod. [size=1](For making small changes.)
[/size][b]. [/b]Compatibility with the SDV Planner website. [size=1](Let's you plan ahead of time.)
[/size][b].[/b] Riverland Fish toggle. [size=1](Enables town/forest fish spawns like the vanilla farm.)[/size]﻿
﻿[size=1](Any other positive suggestions are welcome. :3 )[/size][size=2][/spoiler][/size]
[b][font=Comic Sans MS]﻿[u][b][size=3][u][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#dd7e6b][size=3]Changes﻿:[/size][/color][/font][/u][/size][/b][/u]
[/font][/b][spoiler][b]1.0.0:[/b] Initial Release.
[b]1.1.0 / 1.0.0: [/b]Corrected some bad code & Design.
[b]1.2.0 / 1.1.0: [/b]Added config options & corrected tiles. 
[b]1.3.0 / 1.2.0: [/b]Added multiple configs & a new feature.
[b]1.4.0 / 1.3.0: [/b]Added config options & cleaned up the map.
[b]1.5.0 / 1.4.0: [/b]Added config options, altered map design, revamped code.
[b]1.6.0 / 1.5.0: [/b]Added Config Options, Removed Config Options, Repaired Map layout. [size=1](Updated to SDV 1.6)
[/size][b]1.7.0 / 1.6.0: [/b]Added map/icon compatibility with DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor & cleaned up code.

[size=1](Read Changelog for more details.)[/size][size=2][/spoiler][/size]﻿

[u][b][size=3][u][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#b4a7d6][size=3]FAQ﻿:[/size][/color][/font][/u][/size][/b][/u]
[size=2][b].[/b] [i]"Does this mod work on Android?"[/i][/size]
[size=2][spoiler]- Yes. With the help of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13804]CFL (CustomFarmLoader)﻿[/url] by user: "DeLiXx", you are able to choose this farm on a new save like normal.[/spoiler][/size]
[b]. [/b][i]"I found a bug! Can you fix it?"[/i]
[size=2][spoiler]- If you add a post into the "Bugs" section of this mod (Or the "Posts" section for simple ones), I'll be sure to take a look at it. :D
[color=#d8d8d8](Please be sure to add any extra findings or notes as well. The faster I can locate the issue, the better.)[/color][color=#f4f4f4][/spoiler][/color][/size]
[size=2][b].[/b][i] "Is this mod compatible with expansion type mods?"[/i][/size]
[size=2][spoiler]- TL;DR, yes. I've made my farm 99.9% compatible with mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url], and most others.
[color=#d8d8d8](This also counts for unique events like SVE's enchanted grove.)[/color][color=#f4f4f4][/spoiler][/color][/size]
[size=2][b]. [/b][i]"Is this mod compatible with ___ mod?"[/i][/size][size=1]﻿
[/size][size=2][spoiler]- If the mod does not [u]directly affect[/u] the farm map itself, it's most likely fine.
[color=#d8d8d8](For specifics, give a gander to the "Compatibilities" section above.)[/color][color=#f4f4f4][/spoiler][/color][/size]
[b]. [/b][i]"When is the next update?"[/i]
[size=2][spoiler]- My modding schedule is very inconsistent so be sure to check back in for any future updates. :3
[color=#d8d8d8](The SMAPI console may also prompt you for any newer updates when loading the game, if/when they are released.)[/color][/spoiler]

[i][b]-----/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/\/-----[/b][/i]
[/size]
